issues.description: The fix removed manual `__enter__`/`__exit__`, but it still does not implement the required AsyncCamoufox pattern. `create_browser_context()` remains a synchronous `@contextmanager` (`context.py:30-31`), the module still imports `Camoufox` instead of `AsyncCamoufox` (`context.py:6`), and `_open_camoufox()` uses `with Camoufox(...)` at lines 125 and 132 rather than `async with AsyncCamoufox(...)`. That leaves the original blocking VAL-PY-007 failure unresolved.
